title: Gender Bias in Word Embeddings: A Comprehensive Analysis of Frequency, Syntax, and Semantics
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the semantic association of religious concepts with gender through an unsupervised clustering of the top 1,000 words most associated with men and women. This revealed that a cluster of words related to 'God and Religion' was strongly associated with the male attribute group.
findings: An unsupervised clustering of words highly associated with the male gender in word embeddings revealed a distinct conceptual cluster related to 'God and Religion'. Words in this cluster included 'Allah', 'Bible', 'Christ', 'Christianity', 'Islam', 'Jesus', 'Jews', and 'Muslims', indicating that religious concepts in these language corpora are more semantically associated with men than with women.
